subject: Medicorp VPC/on-prem onboarding — access matrix & preflight evidence request
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@medicorp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Chu <david@medicorp-it.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment intake — Medicorp (VPC + on-prem)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick intro call this AM. We're ready to start the private deployment intake for Medicorp's pilot: a small on-prem inference cluster that will peer to our VPC for model telemetry and telemetry-forwarding.

High level:
- Environment: staging on-prem (3 hosts) + AWS-managed VPC for egress and telemetry.
- Goals: Validate connectivity, TLS+KMS key usage, and basic telemetry forwarding to our Prometheus/ES stack.
- Desired go-live window: mid-June (we know this is tight).

What we need from you to proceed: the onboarding checklist and a list of preflight evidence items we should prepare (network diagram, allowed ports/IPs, KMS/HSM requirements, any docs for the bastion/jump host). If you can share a single intake form we can fill out and return, that'd help us move faster.

I'll loop David (our infra lead) to answer the network questions — David, Kim is our Redwood onboarding lead.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Cloud Engineering
Medicorp Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Private deployment intake — Medicorp (VPC + on-prem)

Hi Samantha — great to meet you this morning. Attaching our intake form and an access-matrix template to make the information exchange quicker. Below is the prioritized preflight evidence list we typically require for a Medicorp-style deployment. Please fill what you can on the attached PDF and return to this thread.

Critical prerequisites (must have before we schedule validation):
1) Account & ownership
   - Account owner name + contact
   - AWS account ID (for peering)
2) VPC details
   - VPC CIDR(s), subnets used for peering, AZ mapping (if applicable)
   - Peering or Transit Gateway details (TGW id)
3) Network rules
   - Egress allowlist for Redwood endpoint IPs (we’ll provide candidate ranges)
   - Inbound rules for the bastion/jump host (SSH IPs)
4) Service identities
   - Service account for telemetry (email) and one service principal with least-privilege roles
5) KMS / key management
   - KMS key ARN(s) or HSM contact / rotation cadence notes
6) TLS certs & SNI
   - Cert chain or plan to use ACM / customer-managed certs
7) Observability endpoints
   - Prometheus scrape targets / pushgateway endpoint and log ingestion endpoint (hostnames + ports)
8) Time sync / NTP policy
9) Test host(s) for smoke traffic and acceptance tests (IP addresses)

Optional but requested for compliance review:
- SOC2 evidence pointers if available (data residency, retention policy)
- Network diagram (Layer 3/4) and firewall rule export

Attachments included:
- onprem_onboard_intake_form.pdf (fillable)
- access_matrix_template.csv

Next steps:
- Please return the intake form and network diagram.
- We will schedule a 60-min network walk-through with our infra engineer (Ben) within 48 hours after we receive the diagram.

If anything is blockers for you now, call me direct.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Onboarding Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Private deployment intake — Medicorp (VPC + on-prem)

Adding some specifics from the network-validation side so Samantha and David know what we'll test during the walk-through and the smoke window. Replying-all with a tentative runbook.

Network validation runbook (high level):
- Pre-checks (day 0): ensure peering/TGW attachments are present and route tables reference destinations. Confirm security group and NACLs do not block 443/8443/5671 (RPC/metrics) and 22 for bastion.
- Connectivity tests (day 1):
  * TCP handshake and TLS negotiation to Redwood collector endpoints from test host (we'll provide hostnames).
  * KMS encrypt/decrypt round-trip from service account (with a test secret) — need KMS IAM binding for our service principal.
  * Prometheus scrape acceptance: confirm registry metrics visible to your push/ingest endpoint.
- smoke traffic (day 2): small load (~10qps) to validate latency and retry behavior
- acceptance criteria: no retries >5% over 60s, TLS validated, metrics received in <120s

Proposed schedule:
- Receive intake + diagram by Friday COB (5/15)
- Network walk-through Monday 5/18 (45–60m)
- Validation window Tues 5/19–Wed 5/20

Attachment: network-validation-runbook.md (detailed checklist and command snippets). I can host the walk-through and run the validations with David on the call.

--
Ben Carter
Senior Technical Onboarding Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Thanks everyone — attaching the network diagram and a preliminary answers sheet. A few notes / clarifications inline:

- Attached: medicorp-vpc-diagram.svg, medicorp-intake-answers.xlsx
- Bastion: we'll provide a single-bastion model with SSH key rotation; attaching a placeholder SSH public key and allowed-jumplist (we'll not put private keys on email).
- KMS / HSM: we use AWS KMS in the account for envelope keys; for production we can discuss a Dedicated HSM — for the pilot, KMS with strict access control is fine. Rotation cadence is 90 days; we can provide rotation policy doc on request.
- Egress IPs: we'll confirm the egress NAT IPs by Monday.

We're aiming for the Monday walk-through. If there's any prewalk command you want us to run to capture firewall logs / route tables, list them and we'll return the outputs.

Thanks,
